hadith:
Knowledge - Narrated Um Salama:

One night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got up and said, "Subhan Allah! How many afflictions have been descended tonight and how many treasures have been disclosed! Go and wake the sleeping lady occupants of these dwellings (his wives) up (for prayers). A well-dressed (soul) in this world may be naked in the Hereafter. "
message: Those who harbor hatred toward you have severed themselves from goodness, yet remain mindful that worldly adornments are fleeting—what truly matters is our spiritual state for the Hereafter. Allah, Al-Badi', the Incomparable Originator, creates all things from nothing with unmatched wisdom, reminding us to awaken our hearts through prayer and consciousness of His divine power, for our souls' true preparation lies in devotion rather than worldly embellishment.
name:
Al Badi' - الْبَدِيعُ - The Incomparable Originator

The name Al Badi' signifies Allah's unique ability to create everything from nothing, emphasizing His unmatched creativity and originality in bringing forth the universe. It reflects the concept of being peerless in creation, underscoring that no one can replicate His divine act of creation. This name originates from the Arabic root 'ب-د-ع' (B-D-A), which conveys the sense of initiating and bringing something into existence without any prior example.
verse:
Al-Kawthar - The Abundance - 108:3

Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺.
